the LAC food system is undergoing a profound transformation and is a major cause of the nutrition transition in the region and its consequences.

the LAC region faces a major nutrition challenge that has been accompanied by a major food system transformation that is in turn accompanied by a major challenge to the food system.

the food system in Latin America has been transformed and is continuing to be transformed in a way that is driving the nutrition transition.
